name: Chateau Barber Shop
tagline: Downtown Napa's walk-in barbershop. Precision cuts, beards, and straight-razor work, first come, first served.
seoTitle: Chateau Barber Shop | Walk-in Barber in Downtown Napa, CA
description: Chateau Barber Shop at 1521 3rd St, downtown Napa. Walk-in barbershop since 2004. Precision haircuts, beards, straight razor shaves. Rated 4.9 on Google. (707) 255-7662.
highlights: Walk-ins only, first come first served

about.title: A downtown Napa institution.
body: Chateau Barber Shop was previously owned by Phil Enlow of Napa. In 2004 he sold the business to Santysouk "San" Yankee, and in 2013 San brought on Napa native Giancarlo "G" Fradella.
The specialties are precision haircuts, beards, straight-razor shaves and line work. No appointments: walk in, grab a seat, and become part of the family.

reviews.text: Been coming here for 10 years and I wouldn't go anywhere else…
reviews.author: Pablo T.

reviews.text: I have brought my grandson here for his haircuts for a couple of years. It's walk-in service and even if you have to wait it's never very long. San and her guys always do a great job.
reviews.author: Denise L.

reviews.text: Best and most consistent barber shop in the valley hands down. After a few cuts, you'll never trust another barber
reviews.author: Jay R.

reviews.text: San is amazing! I’ve been coming here for 10+ years. It’s First Come First Serve but she is efficient! After the first time I came she remembered my style. She’s the best. People wait for her for a reason.
reviews.author: Google review

reviews.text: San has given me the best haircuts for over 10yrs! Thank you & it’s good to be back in Napa. Really friendly local crew.
